metrics.name: assets_usd
metrics.label: Total assets
metrics.description: Total reported assets; excludes off-balance-sheet accounts.

metrics.name: deposits_usd
metrics.label: Total deposits
metrics.description: Total reported deposits; not the domestic-deposit denominator.

metrics.name: domestic_deposits_usd
metrics.label: Domestic deposits
metrics.description: Domestic deposits, retained separately from total deposits.

metrics.name: equity_usd
metrics.label: Total equity capital
metrics.description: Accounting equity; not a regulatory capital ratio.

metrics.name: intangibles_usd
metrics.label: Intangible assets
metrics.description: Reported intangible assets; missing observations remain missing.

metrics.name: net_loans_usd
metrics.label: Net loans and leases
metrics.description: Net loans and leases, not gross loans or originations.

metrics.name: uninsured_deposits_usd
metrics.label: Estimated uninsured domestic deposits
metrics.description: Reported estimate for domestic offices and insured branches in U.S. territories and possessions; divide by domestic deposits only when both observations exist and the denominator is positive.

metrics.name: core_deposits_usd
metrics.label: Core deposits
metrics.description: FDIC source-defined COREDEP measure; not an inference about loyalty or funding stability.

metrics.name: cet1_ratio_pct
metrics.label: Common equity tier 1 ratio
metrics.description: Risk-based CET1 ratio. A value of 12.5 means 12.5 percent; not RBC1AAJ.

metrics.name: leverage_ratio_pct
metrics.label: Regulatory leverage ratio
metrics.description: FDIC leverage ratio-PCA, tier 1 capital divided by adjusted average assets; not CET1.

metrics.name: roa_pct
metrics.label: Return on assets
metrics.description: Annualized by FDIC; never annualize this ratio again. Negative reported values are preserved.

metrics.name: roe_pct
metrics.label: Return on equity
metrics.description: Annualized by FDIC; missing or inapplicable observations remain missing.

metrics.name: employees
metrics.label: Reported employees
metrics.description: FDIC NUMEMP observation, without inferring an employment category beyond the source definition.
